integrity: Exact all-depth shell proof; independent finite enumeration corroborates 14,637 assertions for seven unequal-exponent pairs. All operational evidence and publication review are distinguished from independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Dyadic moduli and distinct odd exponents only. Full target-by-target mixed value fibers, not input-root counts; no characterization of all maximizing shells. General character-convolution literature may implicitly cover individual formulas. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp displacement of maximal fibers in mixed dyadic odd-power value sets
